ok, i managed to re-create your issue. setting my system to dark mode and setting tangled to light mode does that. while we push a fix i'd recommend you to keep tangled in dark mode in the settings if your computer is set to dark mode as well.  
we are currently rewriting our frontend so the appview's current code is on hold, so the fix won't be published yet, just letting you know! :)
